A large grey bat that, despite being herbivorous, is quite aggressive. It is myopic and uses echolocation to navigate.

Max HP: ~3       Will: none       AC: +          EV: +++                        
Threat: Minor   Class: Natural  Size: Tiny      Int: Animal     
Speed: 300% (normally travels faster than you)

You have about 53% to hit with your +2 hand axe and 34% to hit with your headbutt.
It has about 63% to hit you.

Attack  Max Damage  
Hit     1           

It has a 100% chance to notice you each turn.
It is immune to blinding.
It can see invisible.
It can fly.

This monster has been temporarily summoned to this location. Killing it yields no experience or items; it is incapable of using stairs.
